headline: Hermosa Vista Vineyard Estate
articleBody:
3.5-acre pinot gris vineyard with 75' geometric viewing pool, commercial crush pad kitchen, and regenerative soil restoration. Biodynamic practices revived historic site yields. Solar canopy powers irrigation.

Outcome: 25-week phased delivery. Commercial vintage launched Year 2. Wine Spectator silver medal. 34% appreciation verified by appraisal.
